title: Cloud Security for Aegis Logistics: Implementing Vanguard Protocol
objectives: Design a cloud security architecture using the Vanguard Protocol for Aegis Logistics
Implement necessary security controls to protect sensitive data in transit and at rest
Configure access control mechanisms to ensure least privilege and authorised access
prerequisites: Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
Understanding of security and compliance frameworks (e.g. NIST, ISO 27001)
Experience with scripting languages (e.g. Bash) for automation

mission_brief.briefing: Your team has been tasked with implementing a cloud security architecture for Aegis Logistics, a logistics company handling sensitive cargo. Your primary objective is to design and implement a secure architecture using the Vanguard Protocol.
rules_of_engagement: Prioritise security and compliance throughout the design process
Ensure access control mechanisms are configured correctly to prevent unauthorised access
Document all configuration changes for auditing purposes

content.concept: The Vanguard Protocol is an advanced architecture designed to ensure secure data transmission and storage in cloud environments. It combines cutting-edge encryption methods with strict access controls, making it ideal for companies handling sensitive cargo.
content.walkthrough:
This module will walk you through the implementation of the Vanguard Protocol on Aegis Logistics' cloud infrastructure. We will cover topics such as key management, encryption protocols, and access control mechanisms.

Expansion: Walk through expected command outputs, common failure modes, and a verification loop (change → verify → record).
checkpoints: Understanding the importance of key rotation in maintaining cryptographic security
Configuring encryption protocols to ensure data confidentiality
Implementing role-based access controls for least privilege
common_mistakes: Ignoring key rotation, leading to weak cryptography
Insufficiently configuring encryption protocols, resulting in compromised data
Inadequate access control measures, allowing unauthorised users

lab.setup: Create a virtual environment with AWS Cloud9 and install necessary dependencies (e.g. AWS CLI, bash)
steps: Set up an S3 bucket to store encrypted data using AWS KMS
Configure encryption protocols for data in transit using SSL/TLS
Implement IAM policies for role-based access control
